g.text: A cycle is one full round through the three phases, in which each agent acts three times.
Decides which room to move to, or simply stays.
The only allowed actions are move and stay,
and the position fixed here determines
who the agent will meet in the next phase.
Questions another actor in the same room,
explores the room, or examines a corpse
if one is present. A successful dice roll yields a clue.
Uses the gathered clues to name a suspect, a weapon, and a place via accuse,
or passes if not confident. A correct accusation wins; a wrong one kills the accusing agent.
